connector.name: Oriora Router
connector.registryDescription: AI model routing on your own vendor keys: pick the best model per prompt, or route and run it.
connector.summary: Hosted at api.orioralabs.com over streamable HTTP. Access is granted through an authorisation flow, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace com.orioralabs, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: The record references an OAuth flow, so expect a browser consent step rather than a static key. Confirm the scopes on the consent screen before you approve.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Optional: Bearer <your Oriora API key> for the API-key path. Or connect with no header — the server returns 401 + WWW-Authenticate and completes OAuth 2.1 (dynamic client registration) automatically.
